summary:
Implemented `Perc` in [order.py](/Users/andrew/Documents/Class/17679/llm-improvement-loop/llm-improvement-loop/.experiments/ablations/seaborn-heading-run/71d9a302773b5a22/section-11/run-00/generated/seaborn/_stats/order.py), exposing it through `seaborn.objects`. It supports percentile counts and explicit levels, NumPy interpolation methods across old and new keyword names, both orientations, grouping, and missing-value exclusion. Added focused tests, documentation examples, the API listing, and an unreleased feature note.

Targeted tests passed: **7 passed**. The full suite reported **1,785 passed, 81 skipped, 6 xfailed, 1 failed**. The unrelated failure is `tests/test_axisgrid.py::TestFacetGrid::test_subplot_kws`, which expects a `PolarAxesSubplot` type name but the installed Matplotlib returns `PolarAxes`.
